method_evidence.claim: Reference Attention extracts and encodes informative latent from input reference images.
method_evidence.anchor: Our approach leverages Reference Attention to extract and encode informative latent from the input reference images, enabling intuitive and controllable texture generation.

method_evidence.claim: Consistency-Regularized Training enforces stability across varying viewpoints and illumination conditions.
method_evidence.anchor: We also introduce a Consistency-Regularized Training strategy to enforce stability across varying viewpoints and illumination conditions, ensuring illumination-invariant and geometrically consistent results.

method_evidence.claim: Dual-Channel Material Generation separately optimizes albedo and metallic-roughness (MR) textures.
method_evidence.anchor: Additionally, we propose Dual-Channel Material Generation, which separately optimizes albedo and metallic-roughness (MR) textures while maintaining precise spatial alignment with the input images through Multi-Channel Aligned Attention.

method_evidence.claim: Learnable material embeddings capture distinct properties of albedo and MR.
method_evidence.anchor: Learnable material embeddings are further integrated to capture the distinct properties of albedo and MR.
